examples.en: I was so tired that I had to __sit down__ on the **sidewalk**.
I went back home and rested for __a little bit__.
I waited around until it was time for me to __check in__ at my Airbnb.
The first thing I do when going into an apartment or home is to __take off__ my shoes.

phrases.meaning: 超出期待；做得比要求更多

examples.en: But this one __went above and beyond__ my **expectations**.
examples.tc: 超出期待；做得比要求更多

examples.en: I went back home and rested for __a little bit__ before __heading to__ the gym.
It has a big space to __work out__.
After __working out__, I love __going for a dip__ in the pool.
It is always __packed with__ a water bottle, some **goggles**, and a **swim cap**.
Finally, after a long and tiring day, I was __craving something sweet__.

phrases.meaning: 用某件事作為一天的開始

examples.en: I like to __start my day__ by walking around the park.
examples.tc: 用某件事作為一天的開始

examples.en: I found an Italian restaurant just __around the corner__.
I __stopped by__ a little store that was selling dried fruit.
I walked around town __in search of__ something to eat for dinner.
Mexico City can be dry one second and then __raining cats and dogs__ the next.
I had to __go through security__.
The 《view》 was very nice because we were __surrounded by__ trees.

phrases.meaning: 讓自己心情變好；振作起來

examples.en: But to __cheer myself up__, I went to eat my favorite kind of food.
examples.tc: 讓自己心情變好；振作起來

examples.en: It __brought back__ so many memories from Thailand and Vietnam.
I __saved room__ for our second meal.
I am __a little bit of__ a **messy** eater.
I would really **appreciate** it if you would __leave a like__ on this video.

usages.usage: 表示透過某種方式、平台或媒介
examples: Listen to **comprehensible** English 《through》 my slow English **vlogs**.
I was so hungry because I 《took》 the night bus.
So I knew exactly what I needed: **avocado** toast, my favorite, with a beautiful 《view》.
Just outside of the library, I found a little 《stand》 in Chinatown.

breakdowns.sentence: I was so tired that I had to sit down on the sidewalk and rest for a little bit.
breakdowns.translation: 我累到必須坐在人行道上休息一下。

points.label: so + adjective + that 子句
points.text: so + 形容詞 + that + 主詞 + 動詞
points.note: 用來表示程度很高，導致後面的結果。

breakdowns.sentence: I waited around until it was time for me to check in at my Airbnb.
breakdowns.translation: 我一直等到可以在 Airbnb 辦理入住。

points.label: until 時間子句
points.text: waited + until + 主詞 + 動詞
points.note: until 表示某個動作持續到某個時間點才結束。

breakdowns.sentence: The first thing I do when going into an apartment or home is to take off my shoes.
breakdowns.translation: 我進公寓或家裡時做的第一件事就是脫鞋。

points.label: when + V-ing 簡化子句
points.note: when going into 簡化了 when I go into，讓句子更簡潔。

breakdowns.sentence: But the refrigerator was big, and so was the living room.
breakdowns.translation: 但是冰箱很大，客廳也很大。

points.label: so + be動詞 + 主詞
points.note: 用來表示前面的情況也適用於另一個主詞。

breakdowns.sentence: I loved the big windows where I could sit down and work.
breakdowns.translation: 我喜歡那些大窗戶，讓我可以坐下來工作。

points.label: where 關係副詞子句
points.text: 地點名詞 + where + 主詞 + 動詞
points.note: where 引導子句，補充說明地點可以做什麼。

breakdowns.sentence: The water pressure was very strong, which is hard to find sometimes in Mexico.
breakdowns.translation: 水壓很強，這在墨西哥有時很難找到。

points.label: which 指代整個前句內容
points.text: 完整句子 + which + 動詞
points.note: which 不只指一個名詞，而是指前面整件事。

breakdowns.sentence: I've always thought I look so silly with goggles and a swim cap.
breakdowns.translation: 我一直覺得自己戴泳鏡和泳帽看起來很傻。

points.label: 現在完成式
points.note: 表示從過去到現在一直有的想法或經驗。

breakdowns.sentence: I like to start my day by walking around the park, breathing in the fresh air around the trees, and getting my daily intake of sunlight.
breakdowns.translation: 我喜歡用在公園散步來開始一天。

points.label: by + V-ing 表示方法
points.note: by walking 表示用散步這個方式來開始一天。

breakdowns.sentence: I had always wanted one, so I went to get one.
breakdowns.translation: 我一直都想要一顆，所以我就去做了。

points.label: 過去完成式
points.note: 表示在過去某個時間點之前就已經存在的想法或動作。

breakdowns.sentence: I would really appreciate it if you would leave a like on this video.
breakdowns.translation: 如果你願意幫這支影片按讚，我會非常感謝。

points.label: would appreciate it if
points.text: would appreciate it if + 主詞 + would / could + 動詞
points.note: 這是比較客氣地請求別人做某事的句型。
